title: Worksheet — Percentage and Its Applications (Class 10 NIOS Mathematics)
instructions: Attempt all 10 questions. Show all working for the subjective questions. Use the formulas precisely; round monetary answers to two decimals. Total time: 50 minutes.

questions.question: Discount is computed on the marked price.
A 10 % increase followed by a 10 % decrease gives a net change of:
If CP = ₹500 and SP = ₹560, the profit % is:
A salary of ₹30000 is increased by 12 %. Find the new salary.
A radio is sold for ₹540 at a gain of 8 %. Find the cost price.
A shopkeeper marks his goods 25 % above CP and gives a 20 % discount. Find his profit %.
questions.answer: Let CP = 100. MP = 125. SP = 125 · 0.80 = 100 = CP. Profit = 0; profit % = 0.

questions.question: Find the simple interest on ₹2000 at 8 % p.a. for 3 years.
Find the compound interest on ₹2000 at 10 % p.a. for 3 years (yearly compounding). Verify that CI > SI for the same data.
questions.answer: A = 2000 · (1.1)^3 = 2000 · 1.331 = ₹2662. CI = 2662 − 2000 = ₹662. SI for same data = 2000 · 10 · 3 / 100 = ₹600. CI − SI = ₹62 > 0; CI exceeds SI by ₹62, the interest-on-interest piece.
questions.explanation: CI exceeds SI for t > 1 year; the difference is the interest earned by previously credited interest.

questions.question: Mira deposits ₹20000 at 8 % p.a. compounded HALF-YEARLY for 1.5 years. Find the maturity amount and the compound interest.
questions.explanation: A = P · (1 + r/(100·n))^(n·t) with n = 2, t = 1.5 → exponent 3.
